notes.raw:
Phase changes: 830 K, transformation point of chalcopyrite to intermediate solid solution (ISS) + pyrite; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.400$ kcal/mol. 930 K, ISS + pyrite to ISS + pyrite + S(1); $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ . kcal/mol. 1043 K, Curie temperature of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 1155 K, ISS + pyrite + S(1) to liquid CuFeS₂; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 11.045$ kcal/mol. 1185 K, $\alpha - \gamma$ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.215$ kcal/mol. 1357.6 K, melting point of Cu; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 3.120$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-830 K: $Cp^o$ = 21.192 + 12.406x $10^{-3}$ T - 1.780x $10^5$ T $^{-2}$
830-930 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 21.192x $10^{-3}$ T + 6.203x $10^{-6}$ T $^2$ + 1.780x $10^2$ T $^{-1}$ - 7.467 $Cp^o$ = -344.170 + 440.476x $10^{-3}$ T
930-1155 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = -344.170x $10^{-3}$ T + 220.238x $10^{-6}$ T $^2$ + 150.949 $Cp^o$ = 41.200
1155-1500 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 41.200x $10^{-3}$ T - 16.961 $Cp^o$ = 32.820
$H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 32.820x $10^{-3}$ T + 3.763
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-830 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -75.490 + 7.750 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.998 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 345.200 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -75.490 - 7.750 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.998 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 172.600 \text{T}^{-1} + 92.330 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
830-930 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 82.926 - 357.612 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 213.037 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 167.200 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 82.926 + 357.612 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 213.037 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 83.600 \text{T}^{-1} - 2376.508 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
930-1043 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -84.984 + 27.758 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 7.201 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 167.200 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -84.984 - 27.758 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 7.201 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 83.600 \text{T}^{-1} + 233.294 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1043-1155 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -61.423 - 16.223 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 13.510 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 61.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -61.423 + 16.223 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 13.510 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 30.650 \text{T}^{-1} - 73.250 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1155-1185 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -40.699 - 24.603 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 13.510 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 61.300 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -40.699 + 24.603 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 13.510 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 30.650 \text{T}^{-1} - 150.287 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1185-1357.6 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -64.313 + 13.652 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 2.181 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 57.700 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -64.313 - 13.652 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 2.181 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 28.850 \text{T}^{-1} + 121.753 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1357.6-1500 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -65.554 + 11.172 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.371 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 50.700 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -65.554 - 11.172 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.371 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 25.350 \text{T}^{-1} + 105.880 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Johnson (58). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from King (64). High-temperature data based on Pankratz (94) and Conard (24).
